Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
fr.campus.d_and_d.characters.Character
fr.campus.d_and_d.characters.Enemy
All Implemented Interfaces:
CellContent
Direct Known Subclasses:
Dragon, Goblin, Orc, Sorcerer
public class Enemy extends Character implements CellContent
Abstract class representing an enemy character in the game. Enemies can be fought by players and may drop equipment when defeated.
